description: Create an enterprise MCP action template for an organization-hosted Microsoft Sentinel MCP server with governed, identity-backed security operations data access.

ui.helpText: Enterprise template only. Replace the example endpoint with an organization-hosted Sentinel MCP endpoint and enable only after identity, source, destination, per-tool, and audit controls are reviewed.

operatorNotes: Requires Microsoft Sentinel data lake onboarding and product-specific access prerequisites.
Use least-privilege Entra/RBAC assignments and begin with narrow read-oriented tool collections.
warnings: Microsoft Sentinel MCP can expose sensitive alerts, incidents, entities, evidence, and hunting/query results.
Do not enable broad Sentinel tool sets or action-oriented tools until governance and audit controls are mature.
This template is hidden unless explicitly allowed with a preconfiguration:microsoft_sentinel MCP destination policy.
